dialogue_segments.text: Instead she married a nobody, played healer to peasants, challenged people above her. And now the whole county will watch her pay for it.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Chilling Proclamation)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: Let them see what happens when a woman forgets her place.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Clarissa rises from her armchair holding a cut crystal glass filled with dark red wine, pacing toward the fireplace.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Clarissa takes a slow sip of the red wine, her eyes gleaming with dark relish.

sound_fx_segments.label: SOUND FX
sound_fx_segments.text: A deep, ominous cello rumble builds alongside the crackle of the fireplace into an unresolved, tension-filled cliffhanger sting before fading out.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Close-up of Clarissa giving a slight, dismissive scoff before turning to him with cold certainty.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Medium close-up of the nobleman looking down pensively at the open execution clause on the table.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Close-up on Clarissa's face hardening with bitter resentment.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Medium tracking shot showing Clarissa standing tall beside her husband, her posture regal and vindictive.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Tight close-up on Clarissa's face glowing in the firelight. Her lips curl into a merciless smile as she lifts the crystal glass to her mouth and drinks.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Slow push-in on the dark polished tabletop where the open invitation lies beside the wax seal. The bold Gothic lettering "EXECUTION CLAUSE" sits beneath the gold crest, while the fire dances reflected on the mahogany.

logline: As Rupert and Catherine issue wedding invitations paired with Juliana's public execution decree to terrorize the county, Juliana endures starvation in the dungeon, refusing to break her spirit.
continuity_notes: Following Alexander's vow to return in two days to disrupt the wedding, Rupert and Catherine prepare to cement their coup by inviting high society to celebrate their nuptials and witness Juliana's execution.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEMAN (Musing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: She was always stubborn.
